title: Add Parent-Child Relationship Schema
description: Create database migration (26.sql) with two new tables instead of modifying the habits table. A routine is NOT a habit - it is a named container with no entries, scores, or streaks of its own. Schema: (1) 'routines' table with id, name, color, position columns to store routine display properties; (2) 'routine_items' table with routine_id (FK to routines), habit_id (FK to habits, UNIQUE), position columns to map habits into routines. Includes indexes on routine_items(routine_id) and routine_items(habit_id). This approach leaves the existing habits table completely untouched for backward compatibility.
